analysis_document.title: Cognianalysis Product Readiness Analysis
analysis_document.subtitle: Self-analysis of the LLM-first source-code analysis product against the original decision-document vision.
analysis_document.source_basis: Authored from complete-scope Tier 1 coverage of 113 included files, three planned skill workbench reviews, two focused detail reviews, product extraction artifacts, source code, docs, benchmark fixtures and verifier scripts.

executive_decision_basis.summary: Cognianalysis now covers the original product shape in the executable repository state: source-first analysis, LLM-authored strategy and report artifacts, complete Tier 1 coverage, skill/detail reviews, evidence-backed decision sections, benchmark proof and simplified harness contracts.
executive_decision_basis.recommendation: Treat the product as ready for this repository-level readiness gate after strict verification passes, while keeping true agent-run external semantic scoring as the next non-blocking hardening track.

decision_questions.keep_system: Keep and continue hardening Cognianalysis because the product loop, report contract, evidence gates and benchmarks are implemented in source and executable artifacts.
decision_questions.modernize_system: Modernize further by keeping runner-produced orchestration/cache proof reproducible and by expanding true external semantic scoring.
decision_questions.replace_system: Do not replace the system; the current evidence supports incremental hardening rather than restart.
decision_questions.cost: Low short-term cost for refreshing generated analysis artifacts and moderate cost for CI-grade agent-run external semantic scoring.
biggest_risks: Generated analysis artifacts can become stale after source commits.
External semantic quality is still strongest when Codex authors the artifacts in-session.
Parallel/cache proof must remain tied to real artifact hashes, not prose.
next_actions: Run strict verification after every product source change.
Keep live ChatGPT review/recheck after pushes.
Automate more of the external semantic scoring loop when an agent runner is available.

consistency_review.summary: The report consistently describes Cognianalysis as a thin LLM-first harness with deterministic contract validation. It does not claim deterministic code understands semantics, and it treats further external semantic scoring automation as hardening rather than a blocker for the current strict product gate.

skill_workbench_synthesis.summary: The final report integrates all three planned skill workbenches: whole-product story, CLI/artifact/interface contracts and process-quality-readiness.
skill_workbench_synthesis.coverage_statement: 3/3 LLM-planned skill workbenches are incorporated before detail review synthesis.

detail_review_synthesis.summary: The final report integrates the two planned focused detail reviews: core harness/readiness and benchmark/orchestration proof.
detail_review_synthesis.coverage_statement: 2/2 planned detail reviews executed and incorporated.

report_quality_review.summary: The report is decision-ready for the current complete-scope repository run because it starts whole-repository first, covers functional and technical views, covers all four analysis levels, includes examples and quality/security/process evidence, connects major claims to file:line evidence and preserves limitations without blocking questions.

sections.title: Executive Decision
sections.intent: State the product readiness decision before drilldown.

rows.decision: Did Cognianalysis reach the expected product shape for this repository?
rows.recommendation: Yes for the strict repository-level product-readiness gate after verification passes, because the implementation and generated artifacts cover the original decision-document contract.
rows.risk: Generated self-analysis must be refreshed after source commits.

rows.recommendation: Yes for the current harness contract: users operate analyze/status/open/eval while internals stay dev-scoped and auditable.
rows.risk: Advanced users still need .analysis artifacts for audit and LLM workflow execution.

rows.recommendation: Continue automating true agent-run external semantic scoring, but do not block this strict readiness decision on that next hardening track.
rows.risk: Without automation, external semantic proof requires an in-session Codex run.

sections.title: System Understanding
sections.intent: Explain the whole repository as product families rather than a file list.

families.name: Core CLI and harness
families.role: Public product entrypoint plus deterministic task/finalization flow.
families.business_use: Lets users start, inspect, open and evaluate analyses without learning internal workflow commands.
families.technical_shape: TypeScript CLI with analyze/status/open/eval and dev-scoped internals.

families.name: LLM artifact and readiness contracts
families.role: Semantic artifacts and deterministic validation for report readiness.
families.business_use: Turns source evidence into a decision basis while preventing unsupported completion claims.
families.technical_shape: Aggregator, final LLM readiness, product readiness, goal trace and artifact model checks.

families.name: Report renderer and component library
families.role: Stable display system for LLM-authored sections.
families.business_use: Gives management a readable report while preserving drilldown evidence.
families.technical_shape: analysis_document.sections rendered through supported component types.

families.name: Verification and benchmarks
families.role: Executable proof for demo, golden, baseline, external semantic and autonomous handoff behavior.
families.business_use: Supports market and quality claims with repeatable checks.
families.technical_shape: Node verifier scripts and benchmark fixture manifests/results.

families.name: Representative fixtures and skills
families.role: Analysis targets and reusable agent instructions.
families.business_use: Proves the product can cover REST, SOAP, event, fullstack and legacy examples.
families.technical_shape: Example repositories plus skills for business extraction, flow and interface analysis.

sections.title: Functional Flow
sections.intent: Show how the product operates end to end.

blocks.summary: A user runs analyze; the CLI prepares source inventory and task guides; Codex authors strategy, source-tier, skill, detail and final report artifacts; finalize renders; eval checks readiness.
blocks.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[analyze repository] --> B[prepare .analysis context]
  B --> C[Codex strategy and Tier 1 cards]
  C --> D[skill workbenches]
  D --> E[detail reviews]
  E --> F[analysis_document]
  F --> G[finalize and render]
  G --> H[eval strict]

steps.title: Prepare context
steps.description: analyze creates code map, source inventory, task guide and product request.

steps.title: Author semantic artifacts
steps.description: Codex authors strategy, Tier 1 file cards, workbench reviews, detail reviews and final analysis document.

steps.title: Validate and render
steps.description: aggregate validates contracts, evidence, lineage and report components, then renderReport produces HTML.

steps.title: Decide readiness
steps.description: eval strict checks original product readiness including report coverage, examples, evidence, benchmarks, simplified harness and orchestration.

sections.title: Quality, Security and Process
sections.intent: Cover bugs, security, process readiness and evidence integrity.

levels.summary: Complete Tier 1 cards and source-family mapping explain repository responsibilities before detail review.
Readiness, report lint, semantic lineage, evidence validation and verifier scripts expose code/product risks.
next_steps: Keep strict eval in CI and post-push loop.

levels.summary: Package scripts, benchmark docs, CI workflow and AGENTS post-push review rules create a proof-oriented delivery process.
next_steps: Automate true agent-run external semantic scoring when runner access is available.

levels.summary: The target is a thin LLM-first harness with stronger orchestration/cache proof and external semantic automation.
next_steps: Promote proof generation into reusable runner commands.

items.title: Security coverage is explicit at the local CLI and artifact boundary.
items.description: The product has no web-app auth surface in this repo; security coverage is evidence integrity, package fixture inclusion, external finding ingestion and explicit security finding checks.

items.title: Strict readiness prevents unsupported product claims.
items.description: The readiness gate fails until report quality, evidence, source-tier coverage, workbenches, detail reviews, benchmarks and simplification pass.

items.title: Staleness is the main operational risk for generated proof.
items.description: Generated analysis artifacts must be refreshed after commits because analysis staleness compares prepared and current commits.

sections.title: Target Architecture and Next Moves
sections.intent: Convert the readiness review into action.

items.title: Keep the thin public loop as the product surface.
items.benefit: Preserves simplicity for users while keeping audit artifacts available.

items.title: Refresh and verify generated product proof after commits.
items.benefit: Keeps strict readiness truthful after source changes.

items.title: Automate true agent-run external semantic scoring.
items.benefit: Turns in-session external semantic review into repeatable runner proof.

items.title: Maintain runner-produced orchestration/cache proof.
items.benefit: Keeps parallel execution and cache reuse proof reproducible without verifier-fabricated logs.

rows.decision: Position against consulting and gen-AI delivery suites
rows.recommendation: Use Cognianalysis as the first-pass source-grounded discovery and decision basis, then hand off owner-specific decisions to humans or delivery suites.
rows.risk: Do not claim hidden business intent beyond source evidence.

rows.decision: Position against static scanners and architecture maps
rows.recommendation: Complement scanners and architecture graph tools: Cognianalysis adds LLM-authored management narrative, examples and decision synthesis while preserving evidence.
rows.risk: Static scanner findings should remain source-tool authority when imported.
